sn35.82:1.1: kho aññataro bhikkhu yena Bhagavā || la || || Ekam antaṃ nisinno kho so bhikkhu Bhagavantam etad avoca || ||
sn35.82:2.1: Loko loko ti bhante vuccati || || Kittāvatā nu kho bhante loko ti vuccatīti || || Lujjatīti kho bhikkhu tasmā loko ti vuccati || || Kiñca lujjati || || Cakkhu kho bhikkhu lujjati || || Rūpā lujjanti || || Cakkhuviññāṇaṃ lujjati || || Cakkhusamphasso lujjati || pe || || Yam pidaṃ manosamphassapaccayā uppajjati vedayitaṃ sukhaṃ vā dukkhaṃ vā adukkhaṃ asukhaṃ vā || tam pi lujjati || || Lujjatīti kho bhikkhu tasmā lokoti vuccatīti || || Atha
